title: Journalists in Quetta stage sit-in against media bureau closures and layoffs

tea.why: Journalists in Quetta protested against the closure of eleven media bureaus, mass layoffs, and delayed wages affecting media workers.
tea.want: Demanding employment protection, job security, and action against media bureau closures and unpaid salaries.
tea.changed: Nov 24: Protesters completed a two-day sit-in outside the Quetta Press Club following a call by the Pakistan Federal Union of Journalists.

summary: Journalists and media workers in Quetta launched a two-day protest sit-in outside the Quetta Press Club against the closure of eleven media bureaus and the dismissal of numerous media professionals. Organised following a call by the Pakistan Federal Union of Journalists (PFUJ), the demonstration drew participation from journalists, political party representatives, labour unions, lawyers, human rights activists, and civil society members. Speakers highlighted that the bureau closures had impacted the livelihoods of over one hundred families and raised concerns regarding safety and accountability for violence against media workers. No official response or actions by the authorities were detailed in the coverage.
demands: Ensure employment protection and job security
Bring killers of journalists to justice
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: Journalists in Quetta began protesting against television bureau closures, layoffs, and delayed wages.
Balochistan journalists concluded a two-day protest sit-in outside the Quetta Press Club.
